scope: Additive nonserialized core page execution context, explicit registry-local shared rate groups, bounded cooperative subrequest admission and retry delay handling. No live adapter adoption in this slice.

first_passes.result: Existing rate admission was page-level and slot-local; introduce a core-owned context without duplicating downstream rate primitives.
Use an additive defaulted provider method, explicit shared groups and unchanged cache identities; legacy hidden HTTP calls remain unproven.
Test actual admission, cumulative deadlines, denied/cache non-interference and group floors; preserve registry-local and cooperative-adapter boundaries.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Denied live requests and cache hits could permanently raise shared rate floors before admission.
findings_and_fixes.fix: Raise request floors only after actual synchronous factory invocation; add denial/cache regressions.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Scheduling lock was released before factory invocation, overstating factory-start spacing.
findings_and_fixes.fix: Hold scheduling guard through factory invocation, timestamp afterward, then release before awaiting the future.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Test counters measured future-body polling rather than factory invocation.
findings_and_fixes.fix: Add independent synchronous factory counters and denial/deadline/cancellation/cache assertions.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Rate waits now consume the page-attempt timeout, unlike the legacy timing behavior.
findings_and_fixes.fix: Explicitly document and regression-test deliberate conservative tightening; source compatibility does not mean identical timeout behavior. Overall deadline remains unchanged.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Cooperative deadlines cannot preempt blocking factories or futures.
findings_and_fixes.fix: Document nonblocking/cooperative adapter requirements; context is not a sandbox.
